origin.says: Simplified from 嬌: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 乔 (tall) as the sound: lovely, delicate; pampered.

ety.hint: A spear pointing to the bottom-right

origin.says: A drawing of the dagger-axe, a long shaft with a single side blade; the shaft became the long slanting stroke.

戈.name: dagger-axe
戈.in: 或划战找戏域藏载裁械截戴惑戒贼伐栽诫戳筏绒戎哉阀

ety.hint: Dates ⺀ falling off a tree 朿

origin.says: From 棗: two 朿 (thorn) stacked, the thorny jujube tree. The simplified form replaced the lower 朿 with two dots as a repeat mark.

捎.def: to carry, to take; to select

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 肖 as the sound: to take along for someone, to carry.

捎.name: take along

origin.says: 酉 (wine jar, fermented drink) for the meaning plus 各 (each) as the sound: fermented milk, cream, cheese.

蹬.def: to step on; to wear; to face bad luck

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 登 (climb) as the sound: to push down with the foot, step on, pedal.

蹬.name: foot push

媚.def: attractive, charming; to charm, to flatter

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 眉 (eyebrow) as the sound: charming, and to flatter.

媚.name: charm

origin.says: 雨 (rain, weather) for the meaning plus 叚 (to borrow) as the sound, a sound shared with words for red: red clouds at dawn or sunset.

ety.hint: Hand 寸 holding meat ⺼ over an altar 示

origin.says: A hand 又 (hand) offering a piece of meat (肉, written on its side as the top left) over 示 (altar): a sacrifice to the spirits.
Simplified from 贅: 敖 (to ramble, go away) plus 贝 (money): money that has gone out as a pledge, a pawn. From 'attached, linked on' came 'superfluous, extra'. One reading takes 贝 as the sound instead.

ety.hint: A midwife 殳 to helping a pregnant woman 㐆; 㐆 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: A person with a swollen belly 㐆 (big belly) and a hand holding a tool 殳 (strike): treating someone's belly. One reading sees the old word for heartfelt pain; the sense 'abundant, great' came later.
雨 (rain) for the meaning plus 包 (wrap) as the sound: rain wrapped into balls of ice, hail.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus a sound part, now written as 享 (enjoy) (originally a form with 羊 (sheep) under it): pure, unmixed water, hence simple and honest.
此 (this) as the sound plus 隹 (bird) for the meaning: a female bird, hence female.

嘞.def: final particle used to indicate polite refusal

origin.says: 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 累 as the sound: a mule. Simplified from 騾 by writing 馬 as 马.

瘸.def: lameness; paralysis of the hands or legs

origin.says: 疒 (sickness) and 肉 (flesh, body) for the meaning plus 加 (add) as the sound: a bodily ailment, 'lame'.

瘸.name: limp

绊.def: a loop of thread; shackles, fetters; to stumble, to trip

origin.says: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 半 (half) as the sound: a cord tied round the legs, something that trips you. Simplified from 絆 (same build) with the short thread side form.

绊.name: trip rope

origin.says: 犭 (dog) for the meaning plus 昌 (flourishing) as the sound: running wild like a mad dog, rampant.
From 鵑: 肙 (small worm) as the sound plus 鳥 (bird), simplified to 鸟, for the meaning: the cuckoo.
艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 尉 (officer) as the sound: thick, lush plant growth, hence luxuriant and splendid.
尚 (esteem) as the sound plus 衣 (clothing) for the meaning: a lower garment, a skirt; it took over this sense from 常.
From 賢: 臤 (firm) as the sound plus 貝 (shell, money) for the meaning: worthy, valuable as money. Both parts were simplified (臤 to two strokes plus 又, 貝 to 贝).
虫 (worm) for the meaning plus 引 (pull) as the sound: the earthworm, which stretches as it moves.
木 (tree) for the meaning plus 吾 (I) as the sound: the Chinese parasol tree.
虫 (creature) for the meaning plus 丘 (mound) as the sound: the earthworm, which leaves small mounds of soil.
礻 (spirits, altar) for the meaning plus 录 (a form of 彔) as the sound: blessings from the spirits, and an official's salary. Simplified from 祿.

ety.hint: One who fought 斗 a ghost 鬼; 鬼 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 鬼 (ghost) as the sound plus 斗 (ladle) for the meaning: first a big soup ladle, then the head of the Dipper stars, and so the chief or best.

ety.hint: Wages offered 奉 to a person 亻; 奉 also provides the pronunciation

诿.def: to shirk, to pass the buck, to make excuses

仲.def: middle brother; go between, mediator; surname

ety.hint: The middle 中 person 亻; 中 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 中 (middle) as the sound and meaning: the middle brother, and a go-between.

仲.name: middle brother

ety.hint: A plant 艹 armed with thorns 刂

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 刑 (punish) as the sound: thorny brambles, used to make rods for punishment. Written 荊 before; 刑 is now 开 (open) beside 刂 (knife).
石 (stone) for the meaning plus 乐 (joy) as the sound: small stones, gravel. Simplified from 礫 by writing 樂 as 乐.

眶.def: eye socket; the corner of the eye

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 匡 (square basket) as the sound and a hint of a frame: the eye socket.

眶.name: eye socket

origin.says: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 家 (home) as the sound: sowing grain, the crops.

眯.def: to squint, to narrow the eyes; blindness

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 米 (rice) as the sound: narrowing the eyes. It stands for 瞇 (squint), whose sound part 迷 (lost) lost its walking sign.

眯.name: squint

origin.says: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 㐱 (thick hair) as the sound: spots on the skin, a rash.

殉.def: martyr; to die for a cause

origin.says: 歹 (bad death, bones) for the meaning plus 旬 (ten-day period) as the sound: to die for a cause, or to be buried with the dead.

殉.name: martyr

梢.def: the tip of a branch; rudder

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 肖 as the sound: the thin tip of a branch.

梢.name: twig tip

ety.hint: A working 支 woman 女; 支 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 女 (woman) for the meaning plus 支 (branch) as the sound: first a female performer, later a prostitute.
耒 (plough) for the meaning plus 云 (cloud) as the sound: to weed a field.

赡.def: rich, elegant; to support, to provide for

origin.says: 贝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 詹 as the sound: having plenty of wealth, and so providing for others. Simplified from 贍 by writing 貝 (shell) as 贝.

赡.name: provide for

烘.def: to bake, to roast; to dry by the fire

origin.says: 火 (fire) for the meaning plus 共 (together) as the sound: to dry or warm by the fire, to bake.

烘.name: bake

origin.says: 谷 (valley) for the meaning plus 害 as the sound: a wide open gap like a valley, hence open, clear, and to let off.

甄.def: to grade, to examine, to discern; surname

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 谒 (to call on) as the sound: lush plants, then kindly and friendly. Simplified from 藹 by writing 言 as 讠.

湮.def: to block up; to sink; to stain

ety.hint: A dammed 垔 stream 氵; 垔 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus a sound part: soft new grass, downy. One old reading takes the sound from 聰 (clever) cut down to 耳 (ear); others take 耳 itself as the sound.

ety.hint: Speaking 曰 in the daytime 日

origin.says: 日 (sun) plus 口 (mouth), which later became 曰 (to say): calling out at sunrise, then 'bright, flourishing'. Another reading sees two suns, sunlight.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 里 (village) as the sound: a spoken particle, and a sound-based word for the English 'mile'.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 岡, clouds 网 forming over a mountain 山

origin.says: Simplified from 岡: 山 (mountain) for the meaning plus 网 (net) as the sound, a ridge. The simplified form drops 山 and keeps only a reduced net shape.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 滕 (a place name) as the sound: a climbing vine, rattan.

ety.hint: Not 不 needed 用; 用 also provides the pronunciation

瞻.def: to look; to look out for; to respect

origin.says: 目 (eye) for the meaning plus 詹 as the sound: to look up at or look ahead, and so to look up to someone.

瞻.name: look up to

戳.def: to pierce, to prick, to stab; stamp, seal

origin.says: 戈 (dagger-axe) for the meaning plus 翟 (pheasant) as the sound: to jab, prick, stab, and a stamp pressed in.

戳.name: poke

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 匡 (square basket) as the sound: a bamboo basket. 匡 itself was the basket before it took other senses.
𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 溥 (vast) as the sound: a register written on bamboo strips, a notebook or ledger.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 朋 (friend) as the sound: a shed or awning of wooden poles.
In oracle bones two hands holding a pestle (午) over 禾 (grain): pounding grain. The hands and pestle fused into the top shape; the name of a state and dynasty.

冯.def: to gallop; by dint of; surname

origin.says: Simplified from 馮: 冫 (ice) as the sound plus 馬 (horse) for the meaning: a horse galloping; now mostly a surname. 馬 became 马.

冯.name: feng surname

帖.def: card, invite, notice; to fit snugly

origin.says: 巾 (cloth) for the meaning plus 占 (divine) as the sound: writing on a piece of cloth, a note, card or notice.

帖.name: card

恤.def: to help, to relieve, to take pity on

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 血 (blood) as the sound: to feel for someone, to give relief.

恤.name: relief
